cards.ex: She presented a cogent argument for why we should invest in renewable energy.
cards.exUz: U qayta tiklanadigan energiyaga sarmoya kiritishimiz kerakligi haqida ishonchli dalil keltirdi.
cards.uzDef: Mantiqiy, ishonarli va asosli dalil yoki bahs.

cards.ex: The stress of the situation clouded her judgment, and she made a poor decision.
cards.exUz: Vaziyatning stressi uning fikrini chalkashtirib yubordi va u yomon qaror qabul qildi.
cards.uzDef: Xatolikka olib keladigan fikrlash qobiliyatiga xalaqit berish.

cards.ex: The judge exercised discretion and gave the young offender a lighter sentence.
cards.exUz: Sudya ehtiyotkorlik bilan ish ko'rib, yosh jinoyatchiga yengilroq jazo berdi.
cards.uzDef: O'z fikriga qarab qaror qabul qilishda ehtiyotkor bo'lish.

cards.ex: The monster under the bed was just a figment of his imagination.
cards.exUz: Krovat ostidagi maxluq shunchaki uning xayoliy narsasi edi.
cards.uzDef: Faqat xayolda mavjud bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: He often indulges in flights of fancy about winning the lottery.
cards.exUz: U ko'pincha lotereyada yutish haqida xayoliy parvozlarga beriladi.
cards.uzDef: G'ayrioddiy, amaliy bo'lmagan xayollar.

cards.ex: She needed to get a grip before she could speak calmly.
cards.exUz: U xotirjam gapirishdan oldin o'zini qo'lga olishi kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: O'z his-tuyg'ularini nazorat qilish.

cards.ex: The artist was given free rein to design the mural.
cards.exUz: Rassomga devoriy rasmni loyihalash uchun erkinlik berildi.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir o'zi xohlaganidek harakat qilishiga ruxsat berish.

cards.ex: The government is grappling with the issue of rising unemployment.
cards.exUz: Hukumat ishsizlikning oshishi muammosi bilan kurashmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin masala yoki muammo bilan kurashish.

cards.ex: He harbored a grudge against his former business partner.
cards.exUz: U sobiq biznes sherigiga nisbatan adovat saqlagan.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqt davomida kimdirdan xafa bo'lish.

cards.ex: I have a hazy memory of that summer vacation.
cards.exUz: Menda o'sha yozgi ta'til haqida xira xotira bor.
cards.uzDef: Aniq bo'lmagan yoki qisman esda qolgan xotira.

cards.ex: It's important to keep things in perspective during a crisis.
cards.exUz: Inqiroz paytida narsalarni muvozanatda saqlash muhim.
cards.uzDef: Voqeani to'g'ri baholash va uning ahamiyatini unutmaslik.

cards.ex: We need to create a level playing field for all businesses.
cards.exUz: Biz barcha bizneslar uchun teng sharoit yaratishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Adolatli va teng imkoniyatlar.

cards.ex: We shouldn't lose sight of our original goals.
cards.exUz: Biz asl maqsadlarimizni unutib qo'ymasligimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Asosiy maqsad yoki ahamiyatni unutish.

cards.ex: Chess requires a high degree of mental agility.
cards.exUz: Shaxmat aqliy chaqqonlikning yuqori darajasini talab qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Tez va osonlik bilan fikrlash qobiliyati.

cards.ex: I had a nagging doubt about whether I had locked the door.
cards.exUz: Menda eshikni qulflaganim haqida bezovta qiluvchi shubha bor edi.
cards.uzDef: Yoqimsiz va tinimsiz takrorlanadigan shubha.

cards.ex: She's been on an even keel since she started meditating.
cards.exUz: U meditatsiya qilishni boshlaganidan beri muvozanatda.
cards.uzDef: Barqaror va xotirjam holatda.

cards.ex: He spent hours poring over the documents.
cards.exUz: U hujjatlarni diqqat bilan o'rganish uchun soatlab vaqt sarfladi.
cards.uzDef: Diqqat bilan va uzoq vaqt davomida o'qish yoki o'rganish.

cards.ex: She's quick-witted and always has a clever comeback.
cards.exUz: U ziyrak va har doim aqlli javobga ega.
cards.uzDef: Tez va aqlli javob berish qobiliyatiga ega.

cards.ex: He tried to rationalize away his bad behavior.
cards.exUz: U yomon xatti-harakatini oqlashga harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri yoki xato harakatni mantiqiy qilib ko'rsatishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: She sets great store by her family's opinions.
cards.exUz: U oilasining fikrlariga katta ahamiyat beradi.
cards.uzDef: Nimagadir katta ahamiyat bermoq.

cards.ex: After sober reflection, he decided to resign.
cards.exUz: Chuqur o'ylagandan so'ng, u iste'foga chiqishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Chuqur va jiddiy o'ylash.

cards.ex: She took umbrage at his rude comments.
cards.exUz: U uning qo'pol izohlaridan xafa bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Xafa bo'lish yoki norozilik bildirish.

cards.ex: He was under the misapprehension that she was married.
cards.exUz: Uning noto'g'ri tushunchasi bor edi, u turmushga chiqqan deb o'yladi.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri fikrga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: She has a vivid recollection of her childhood.
cards.exUz: Uning bolaligi haqida yorqin xotirasi bor.
cards.uzDef: Aniq va batafsil xotira.

cards.ex: I'm wrestling with the decision of whether to move.
cards.exUz: Men ko'chib o'tish yoki o'tmaslik qarori bilan bahslashmoqdaman.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin qaror yoki muammo bilan bahslashish.

cards.ex: She yearned for knowledge and spent hours in the library.
cards.exUz: U bilimga intilib, kutubxonada soatlab vaqt o'tkazdi.
cards.uzDef: Bilim olishga kuchli istak.

cards.ex: The police zeroed in on the suspect.
cards.exUz: Politsiya gumondorga diqqatini jamladi.
cards.uzDef: Diqqatni aniq bir narsaga qaratish.

cards.ex: He cast aspersions on her honesty.
cards.exUz: U uning halolligiga tuhmat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir xarakteriga yoki obro'siga shubha tug'diruvchi gaplar aytish.

cards.ex: I'm willing to give him the benefit of the doubt.
cards.exUz: Men unga ishonch bildirishga tayyorman.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir rost so'zlayotganiga yoki to'g'ri harakat qilayotganiga ishonish.

cards.ex: Our working hypothesis is that the virus is airborne.
cards.exUz: Bizning ishchi farazimizga ko'ra, virus havo orqali yuqadi.
cards.uzDef: Vaqtinchalik qabul qilingan, sinovdan o'tkaziladigan faraz.
